scientific_intent.scientific_task: Encode typed FP16, BF16 and FP32 activation rows as Int8 codes, with static or per-token dynamic scaling and optional asymmetric zero points.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Round to nearest even and clamp to Int8. Symmetric dynamic scale is max(abs(x))/127; asymmetric scale is (max(x)-min(x))/255 with an Int32 zero point. The source uses Float32 arithmetic after loading each typed input.
scientific_intent.discretization: 17 rows for each hidden size 513 and 5137, each in actual FP16, BF16 and FP32 storage; four quantization modes give 24 timed paths. Every primary row has true extrema -128 and127, mixed signs and nonzero range. Static rounding boundaries and a final-lane extremum exercise dtype rounding and non-power-of-two workgroups.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All Int8 codes, Float32 scale arrays, Int32 zero-point arrays and every guard are exact against independent Float32 operation-sequence and native CPU oracles. Encoding correctness is separate from lossy reconstruction error and clipping, which are also recorded.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Named small token batch17, hidden513 or5137, actual513 or1024 threads per block. Twenty launches per path, five outer trials, mean only trials2–5. This is not the original4096-token default throughput regime.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Input storage is genuinely16/16/32bits; arithmetic/reductions/scales are Float32 and codes Int8. Integer rounding/index operations are Int32 in Julia; native token offsets use Int64. Float64 is lossless artifact serialization only. BFloat16s0.6.2 is already pinned through CUDA, with no environment change.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Quantization is relevant to activation storage/compression for inference. No trained LLM, downstream task accuracy, calibration generalization or end-to-end inference speed is measured.
scientific_intent.description: Original native GPU kernels and launch wrappers are byte-identical. A named harness bypasses a CUDA12.0 host-generator BF16 assignment compile error. The genuine Julia reference was repaired for a demonstrated513-thread reduction omission and for true BF16 storage. KA and JACC implement the same manual1024-slot trees, while native CUDA uses CUB block reductions.
scientific_intent.provenance: Actual native/old Julia witnesses and typed GPU storage checks are preserved. An all-negative native min/max initialization limitation is diagnosed outside the primary mixed-row contract. Full output and source-prefix byte audits distinguish scientific assumptions from framework support.
